title: Enterococcus mundtii regulates SfCYP6B39 expression to modulate chlorantraniliprole resistance in Spodoptera frugiperda.
authors: Ren, Zhijie; Hu, Ziwei; Bao, Yueyue; Qin, Wu; Qin, Jiangmei; Wan, Hu; Tan, Huihua; Chen, Hongsong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肠道共生菌通过转录因子CncC/BR-C调控宿主P450基因表达增强杀虫剂抗性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作（转录因子调控）和分子动力学模拟，但核心是微生物-宿主调控而非TF-DNA结合机制建模，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: Microbiota-mediated adaptation is increasingly recognized as an important driver of insecticide resistance. Here, we demonstrate that gut symbionts promote chlorantraniliprole resistance in Spodoptera frugiperda through transcriptional regulation of host detoxification pathways. Resistant populations exhibited a distinct gut microbial community dominated by Enterococcus mundtii, accompanied by elevated cytochrome P450 (P450) activity and widespread upregulation of detoxification genes. Disruption of the gut microbiota reduced resistance, suppressed P450 activity, and downregulated multiple P450 genes, whereas recolonization with E. mundtii SC1 restored these effects. Functional analyses employing RNA interference and transgenic Drosophila melanogaster identified SfCYP6B39 as a key gene contributing to resistance. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations further revealed that chlorantraniliprole can stably bind to SfCYP6B39. Mechanistically, E. mundtii SC1 promotes SfCYP6B39 overexpression via the transcription factors CncC and BR-C, forming a microbe-host regulatory axis that links symbiont presence to detoxification gene activation. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that gut symbionts enhance insecticide resistance through transcriptional reprogramming of host detoxification networks, providing mechanistic insight and suggesting microbiome-targeted strategies for sustainable pest management.
abstract_zh: 微生物介导的适应日益被认为是杀虫剂抗性的重要驱动因素。在此，我们证明肠道共生菌通过宿主解毒途径的转录调控促进草地贪夜蛾（Spodoptera frugiperda）对氯虫苯甲酰胺的抗性。抗性种群表现出以蒙氏肠球菌（Enterococcus mundtii）为主的独特肠道微生物群落，伴随细胞色素P450（P450）活性升高及解毒基因的广泛上调。破坏肠道微生物群可降低抗性、抑制P450活性并下调多个P450基因，而用蒙氏肠球菌SC1（E. mundtii SC1）重新定殖则恢复这些效应。利用RNA干扰和转基因黑腹果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster）的功能分析鉴定出SfCYP6B39为贡献抗性的关键基因。分子对接和分子动力学模拟进一步揭示氯虫苯甲酰胺能稳定结合SfCYP6B39。机制上，蒙氏肠球菌SC1通过转录因子CncC和BR-C促进SfCYP6B39过表达，形成连接共生菌存在与解毒基因激活的微生物-宿主调控轴。综合来看，这些发现表明肠道共生菌通过宿主解毒网络的转录重编程增强杀虫剂抗性，提供机制性见解，并提出针对微生物组的可持续害虫管理策略。
